en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a formal city park with circular flowerbeds and walking paths leading to a large neoclassical building with a central dome-like roof and grand portico. Long, tree‑lined boulevards extend to the left and right, bordered by ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs. In the distant background are low hills and another tall church spire. There is a short handwritten message across the top margin.
